notes.title: HUSH - Crane Beta Release
notes.notes:
Welcome to San Rosa.

Underneath its picturesque skyline a cesspit of vice and corruption plagues the night. Join Bambi, a morally ambiguous henchman, as you guide him through a night of crime and survival - where every decision rests upon your touch.

Love or loyalty? You choose.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Hello everyone!

We've been working hard at Flavourworks and, following the resounding success of our first release 'Erica', we're excited to share with you the next evolution of immersive entertainment. You've all been so incredibly supportive over the past few years and we'd love to give our most loyal supporters the chance to experience the newest Touch Video project - for free!

'[b]HUSH[/b]' is our new episodic crime anthology series and '[b]Crane[/b]' is its first short chapter - allowing you to preview just how powerful our Touch Video technology has become and what the rest of the series will entail. '[b]HUSH[/b]' is available to trial in our closed beta for iOS and Android devices [url=https://www.flavourworks.co/hush-beta]here[/url]!

Invitations will be distributed periodically from the 22nd November to a limited amount of players so make sure to sign up as soon as possible - we can't wait to see your reactions!

Wishing you all a fantastic day - and, once again, thank you for your continued support of our small studio and its projects.

- The FLAVOURWORKS team

notes.title: Minor bugfix patch 1.02
notes.notes:
They're coming in fast! This one fixes issues that people on high-refresh rate displays were seeing, like getting stuck on the wiping of the plaque, having issues opening the zippo, or not showing videos on startup.

Please post any issues you're still having on the Technical Support forum. Everyone here at Flavourworks is really excited to see people play Erica.

Thanks!
Pavle

notes.title: Minor bugfix patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Fixed issue where some players on high refresh rate monitors were getting stuck wiping the dust off the plaque in the garden.

If you have any issues, please visit our Technical Support discussions forum!

Thanks for playing!
